title: npw-cabin-boy
label: Mickey D

won.source: No won-date survives; the reign is recorded only in the past tense, years later, by a third party.

how: Unrecorded. The reign is known only from Tsunami Oni's own recollection of it in a PTC roleplay of 24 April 2005 (/promotions/ptc/rp/cw2-rp-making-bath-time-fun.html), which names the holder and the belt and nothing else.
note: Filed with an unminted holder: "Mickey D" is a competitor in PTC's own Cruiserweight Tournament 2 and a trainee of Tsunami Oni's in the UWF corpus, but has no registry row yet and his principal promotion is PTC, not NPW — the mint belongs to a PTC-scoped pass, not this one. The past tense ("he WAS Cabin Boy Champion") is the only evidence the reign ended; no losing match, date or successor survives.
